senses.gloss: m. (preced.) clinging to, following the example of; habit.
units: <cite ref="Niddah 67b:13">Nidd. 67ᵇ</cite> <he>משום ס׳ בתה</he> because her daughter might follow her example (and make the mother’s exceptional act a rule for all occasions).

<cite ref="Chullin 106a:11">Ḥull. 106ᵃ</cite> <he>נטילת … משום ס׳ תרומה</he> the washing of hands before a meal on secular food was introduced for the sake of uniformity with T’rumah (to make it a habit).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yoma 3:3:4">Y. Yoma III, 40ᵇ</cite> bot., sq. <he>טבילת ס׳</he> an immersion required merely for the sake of uniformity; Bab.

<cite ref="Yoma 30a:8">ib. 30ᵃ</cite> <he>ס׳ טבילה</he>. Y. Bicc. III, 64ᵈ bot.; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Chagigah 2:5:3">Y. Ḥag. II, 78ᵇ</cite> <he>נטילת ס׳</he> washing of hands (before meals) for the sake of uniformity (v. supra).
